search_products.title: Search products
search_products.description: Search the product catalog by keyword and optional category. Returns matching products with id, name, price and a link. Use get_product_details for full information on one product.

category.description: Category name or id from list_categories.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

get_product_details.title: Get product details
get_product_details.description: Get full details for one product by its id or SKU.

list_categories.title: List categories
list_categories.description: List the product categories customers can browse.

check_stock.title: Check stock
check_stock.description: Check how many units of a product are available, optionally at one location.

get_pricing.title: Get pricing
get_pricing.description: Get the price for a quantity of a product, including any customer-specific or volume discount.

customer_id.description: Customer account id, for contract pricing.

create_quote.title: Create quote
create_quote.description: Create a price quote for a customer. Without confirm=true it only returns a preview; nothing is saved until confirmed.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved the preview.

create_order.title: Create order
create_order.description: Place an order from an accepted quote. Without confirm=true it only returns a preview. Places a real order when confirmed.

quote_id.description: Id of the quote to convert.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved the preview.

get_order_status.title: Get order status
get_order_status.description: Look up the status of an existing order.
